name: JSHookMCP
description: JSHookMCP is a TypeScript MCP server (npm: @jshookmcp/jshook, AGPL-3.0) that gives AI agents 600+ tools across 36 capability domains: browser automation, CDP debugging, network capture and protocol analysis, JavaScript hooking and deobfuscation, cross-platform native FFI (Win32/Darwin/Linux), and declarative workflow orchestration. Run it with a single npx command.
